sampling.metric: mean linear RGB composite MSE across three backgrounds plus alpha coverage MSE
sampling.gpu_model_limit: axis-aligned integral sRGB8 premultiplied mip approximation; transformed/trilinear sampling requires native captures

shading.transcript: Visual inspection of shading/bounded-comparison.png, three columns: unlit, ao_untextured, studio_neutral. The Focus SVT is blue with white headlights and black window regions in both unlit and ao_untextured. The Ford GT has a red body, white racing stripes, round white number markings, and a visible rear engine panel in both unlit and ao_untextured. In the earlier shading/comparison.png, all-material AO darkens those headlight and engine details. The SC430 has a white body and exposed engine area in both unlit and ao_untextured; the latter shows darker narrow recesses near its window edges. The MCLA GT-R is a nearly flat white silhouette in unlit, with a few dark slits; ao_untextured makes its hood creases, vents, bumper outlines and roof boundary visible. The MCLA Camaro is also nearly flat white in unlit; ao_untextured reveals hood, roof and bumper contours. Window regions on those MCLA cars remain pale; missing native glass colour has not been recovered. All three columns have matching outer shapes. The neutral studio column has softer shading and visible render noise. This is an agent's image transcript, not an independent verification of the pixels.
shading.limit: Occlusion is geometry-derived preview shading, not recovered native game lighting. Neutral reconstructed materials remain neutral. The full PBR reference is a controlled Blender presentation, not an authentic native game capture.

limits: AB choices can be arbitrary on visually identical inputs. No universal perceptual win is claimed. Score distributions and Noul uncertainty are retained. Box estimates never crop sprites; exact geometry and alpha bounds remain authoritative.
